subject: SurgePay POC: connectivity handoff and integration accountabilities
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara.park@surgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SurgePay POC: connectivity handoff and integration accountabilities

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed acceptance criteria and owners so we can lock the POC timeline. Please confirm or flag anything you want changed.

High-level success criteria (what SurgePay needs to validate during the 3-week POC):
- End-to-end inference with representative payloads (up to 2k tokens) with streaming responses to the client UI.
- API parity: calls to /v1/generate (streaming) and /v1/call-tool (tool/function-calling) behave with expected error semantics.
- Latency SLO: median token latency <= 45ms for representative traffic pattern.
- Data controls: logs off by default; audit-log export for token-level events available on request.
- Security: private deployment connectivity test (VPC peering) completed and connection verified.

Integration scope and tech notes:
- SDKs: Ben will provide the Node + Python SDK samples and a streaming example that uses our chunked SSE format. Proposed routes: POST /v1/generate (streaming), POST /v1/embeddings, POST /v1/call-tool for structured function calls.
- KV cache and session routing: we'll share recommended KV/cache settings for low-latency interactive sessions.
- Fallback policy: when dedicated capacity is saturated, requests will route to a compatible quantized model variant. We will surface this in the SDK via the status/headers.
- Connectivity: we will run an initial VPC peering test then fallback to TLS over the public endpoint while peering is being completed.

Proposed owners and dates:
- Ben Carter (SDK + streaming examples) — deliver initial SDK bundle and sample app by 2026-08-24.
- Jonas Weber (integration orchestration + rollout) — orchestrate peering test and end-to-end validation, target 2026-08-26.
- Marissa Cole (PO/acceptance, timeline) — drive test plan and acceptance sign-off, target 2026-08-28.

Attachments: surgepay_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (checklist + test vectors), surgepay_network_arch.png (initial peering diagram).

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara to confirm acceptance criteria and any additional security requirements by EOD Thursday (2026-08-19).
2) Ben to push SDK samples to the shared Drive by 2026-08-24.
3) Kickoff technical sprint (30–60 min) to schedule peering window — can we do Friday morning PST?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Data retention: SurgePay needs confirmation that request/response payloads are not retained by default during the POC (logs off by default is fine, but we need a written confirmation).
- VPC peering: our infra team prefers to do an initial smoke test against a staging public endpoint before opening a peering window. Can Ben provide a short script/test harness for that?
- Success criteria: can we add one UX acceptance gate — streaming must append tokens within 200ms per chunk under the demo load.

We can confirm the acceptance criteria by 2026-08-19 EOD. Friday morning PST works for a 30 min tech sync — Sara + Tom from infra will attend.
